cim: NYC lawmakers seek pole position in AI regulatory race
cim_eredeti: NYC lawmakers seek pole position in AI regulatory race
szoveg_eredeti:
The City Council is looking to pass new artificial intelligence legislation in January.

NEW YORK — The New York City Council plans to kick off 2027 by voting on a suite of artificial intelligence bills that would put the city at the vanguard of efforts to rein in frontier AI technology amid growing concern about its existential threats to society.

The legislation is being shepherded by Council Speaker Julie Menin, a Manhattan lawmaker who’s emerged as a foil to New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani on a range of issues, including AI regulation. Her plans to call a vote on the bill package in January was confirmed by two people with knowledge of the timing, who were granted anonymity to discuss private deliberations.

The measures serve as a counterpoint to federal inaction on AI that has amounted to a regulatory vacuum.

A spokesperson for Menin said the bills are still undergoing review and noted that an exact date hasn’t been set yet for a vote.
